reviews.text: He is a very caring and kind doctor. He carefully explains the treatment options and presents them with choices. I have received his care countless times and have always trusted him to take care of my pet no matter what. The nurses and reception staff are also kind, and it is a truly excellent hospital. After my pet became ill at the age of 7, I also had him groomed here, and I felt completely at ease leaving him in their care. When he became ill just before turning 15, I am grateful for the careful treatment he received, from cardiopulmonary resuscitation to angel care.

The doctor is a very nice person, but the receptionist was too harsh. It's a business after all, so you shouldn't expect that treating customers is enough to get by. I was left feeling awful. I won't go into details because I could be identified, but I think a lot of people have had the same experience.

The patient came to the hospital because they had been eating little and not having a bowel movement for several days. For some reason, instead of an X-ray, they performed an ultrasound and palpation. They said there didn't seem to be an obstruction and suggested medication to monitor the situation. However, their condition didn't improve, and abdominal distension developed, so we requested an X-ray. As expected, there was an obstruction and severe gas buildup. They performed surgery immediately, and the patient passed away the next morning (this was unavoidable).
We called to inform them of the death and to cancel the appointment, but the doctor in charge never called back.

There was a large, hard foreign body, and gas buildup should have been clearly visible during the ultrasound... what exactly were they looking at on the ultrasound?

As is often the case, the way they communicate is always vague and contradictory, as they try to avoid being held accountable later.

That's the kind of hospital it was.

The doctor is always sincere and attentive, making them truly trustworthy.

The reception staff and nurses are also very polite and reassuring.

I look forward to continuing to receive your care.
I think it's inappropriate not to answer the phone.
